acceptance_signals: One newly created local disposable Git consumer has a committed baseline, an unchanged named target, no related task collision, one strict local Adapter metadata file, and one unused rpf correlation identifier before the check.

The development-source replay-preflight CLI is invoked exactly once against that disposable consumer and returns a machine-readable READY result with exit code 0, or the rehearsal stops and records the exact BLOCKED, UNKNOWN, malformed-input, or operational result without retry.

No model session, consumer replay, task admission in the disposable consumer, cleanup of a real consumer, Adapter installation, network call, Git remote operation, publication, release, or deployment occurs.

Sanitized evidence records only the synthetic plan facts, stable result and reason codes, command outcome, authority boundary, and temporary-environment disposition; it contains no raw prompt, transcript, credentials, private data, or unrelated absolute path.

The task record, dated development log, experiment record, and STATUS remain consistent; JSON parsing, focused preflight tests, task and repository governance, secret-safety inspection, and git diff check complete with unresolved gaps reported.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-92a52945ef8d4d3f8f614535b4d2330a and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control. On 2026-08-16 the synthetic no-remote consumer was created, the development-source preflight was invoked exactly once, and it returned READY with six PASS findings and no reason codes while granting no authority. Focused tests and the complete supported-Python suite passed, sanitized evidence was recorded, and bounded current-Agent review found no correction-required drift. The task is paused so it cannot authorize a second preflight, replay, cleanup, real-consumer change, Git operation, publication, release, deployment, or follow-on work.

requirement.summary: Create one local disposable Git consumer with an explicit clean target state and trustworthy local Adapter metadata, construct one strict replay-preflight plan, run the development-source preflight exactly once without launching a replay, and record only sanitized readiness evidence in the starter repository.

items: Temporary setup writes must remain confined to a newly created disposable directory and must not alter a real consumer or Git remote.
Running the check more than once would violate the one-shot measurement boundary.
Evidence could overstate READY as replay authorization or product-effectiveness proof.
Existing unrelated untracked .codex content, cover image, and AIRBNB task record must remain untouched.
Reviewed assumption: A synthetic disposable repository under a local temporary directory is sufficient to exercise the implemented preflight without representing a real consumer.
Reviewed assumption: Adapter id openai.codex-mcp, version 1.5.0, and protocol 2026-07-28 are the intended synthetic metadata values for this rehearsal.
Reviewed assumption: A READY result establishes only that the exact named prerequisites hold at check time and grants no replay or write authority.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the first real disposable-consumer invocation will return READY on this Windows host.
Reviewed unknown: Whether any platform-specific Git or path behavior will produce an UNKNOWN result.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a future separate product decision should add correlation reservation or run an actual consumer replay.

title: Rehearse one disposable-consumer replay preflight
